deities.name: Bastveig
deities.rationale: Tides, reefs, trenches, coral stewardship, and ocean civilization are Bastveig’s explicit domains.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Horundar
deities.rationale: Hydromancy, pressure changes, floods, and powerful currents connect Tamhiogal elemental rites to Horundar.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Sokhivar
deities.rationale: Bioluminescent display and resonant communication give Sokhivar a secondary role in music-and-light observances.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
